Rechberger, K., Spanlang, A., Sasiain Conde, A., Wolfmeir, H. and Harris, C. (2020). Green Hydrogen-Based Direct Reduction for Low-Carbon Steelmaking. steel research international 91(11), 2000110. https://doi.org/10.1002/srin.202000110

Full read (10 pages). Loaded: process-model results (m.SIMTOP, K1-MET/voestalpine) for a MIDREX-type DR-NG reference, a 30% H2 blend and a ~95% H2 DR process, all per t DRI and DR core only (no pellet plant, no EAF, no electrolyser); reprinted literature values (MIDREX/Millner 2017, ArcelorMittal Hamburg/Hoelling 2017, EAF from Kirschen 2011 and BREF) tagged reprinted. Volumes are m3 at STP as printed; H2 volumes also converted to kWh/t with the printed HHV 3.54 kWh/m3. Electrolysis electricity (3400-3600 kWh/t DRI at 75% HHV) is upstream hydrogen supply and kept in other-values. No costs in the paper. Values in Figs 5-10 read off charts not extracted. Locator: printed article page numbers "N of 10". Trap: Table 1 prints iron input as 1.391 kg/t DRI; text says 1.4 t/t, read as t/t in flows.
